{{Resonator Tabs}} {{Language Tabs}} ==About Voicelines== {{VO |character = Lumi |language = en |vo_01_01_title = Thoughts: I |vo_01_01_file = {character}{language} Thoughts I.ogg |vo_01_01_tx = Hey, I've been hearing about you for ages! How? {{Extra Effect|Lollo Logistics|Lollo Logistics|Lollo Logistics is a trusted logistics company that delivers not only the tangible, but also the intangible.
Whether it's sending sweet words to a loved one or retrieving lost memories, if it's ordered and can be delivered, Lollo Logistics will handle them with care.}} has stations everywhere, so news travels fast! And, in case you don't know, you're the talk of {{Extra Effect|Jinzhou|Jinzhou|Jinzhou, a fortified city on the frontier, stands guard against the looming Tacet Discord crisis. As one of Huanglong's six major regions, it bears the weight of this responsibility as the youngest provincial capital. The Midnight Rangers defend its northern border without hesitation.}}! |vo_01_02_title = Thoughts: II |vo_01_02_intimacy = 1 |vo_01_02_file = {character}{language} Thoughts II.ogg |vo_01_02_tx = This Terminal ringtone? Yeah, I made it! Thought it'd be a cool way to get the {{Extra Effect|Lollo Logistics}} name out there… It's catchy, right? My colleagues thought so too and all started using it. Now it's ringing everywhere. |vo_01_03_title = Thoughts: III |vo_01_03_intimacy = 2 |vo_01_03_file = {character}{language} Thoughts III.ogg |vo_01_03_tx = This is Squeakie, my plushie. Here, give it a squeeze—isn't it adorable? I made it when I first joined {{Extra Effect|Lollo Logistics}}. Everything was new, I mean, scarily new… and I was super nervous about the job… So having Squeakie around was such a comfort! |vo_01_04_title = Thoughts: IV |vo_01_04_intimacy = 3 |vo_01_04_file = {character}{language} Thoughts IV.ogg |vo_01_04_tx = My nail polish is all chipped off… Time for a new color! When I first moved to the city, I tried all sorts of looks so I could fit in, but always ended up looking silly! Now… Now I've found my own style. So, what color d'you think I should go with? |vo_01_05_title = Thoughts: V |vo_01_05_intimacy = 4 |vo_01_05_file = {character}{language} Thoughts V.ogg |vo_01_05_tx = I never left my village growing up, but once I did, I became a restless traveler. Riding my bike with the wind in my ears just feels amazing. I keep meeting new people, and saying goodbye to them… it's all part of the journey, isn't it? I bet you're the same, always on the move. Great way of living, right? I think... we'll surely meet again somewhere down the road. And when we do, let's grab some local food and catch up on our adventures! |vo_02_01_title = Lumi's Hobby |vo_02_01_file = {character}{language} Hobby.ogg |vo_02_01_tx = I jot down all the interesting sights, people, and events in my travel journal. If words don't cut it, I sketch it out. I've filled up so many journals since joining {{Extra Effect|Lollo Logistics}}! |vo_02_02_title = Lumi's Trouble |vo_02_02_file = {character}{language} Trouble.ogg |vo_02_02_tx = There's never enough time! Delivering packages, planning new routes, catching up with friends, keeping my journal... Oh I wish I could be in a million places at once！ |vo_02_03_title = Favorite Food |vo_02_03_file = {character}{language} Favorite Food.ogg |vo_02_03_tx = Rice noodles are my absolute favorite! Spice it up with chili, a dash of vinegar, sprinkle some green onions... delicious! Next time you're in Yuezhou, I'll treat you! |vo_02_04_title = Disliked Food |vo_02_04_file = {character}{language} Disliked Food.ogg |vo_02_04_tx = Hmm... What did they call it? Some local speciality noodle I tried during a delivery, with this golden fish broth and green veggies. Did NOT taste as good as it looked—ugh, it was so bitter! Never again! |vo_02_05_title = Ideals |vo_02_05_file = {character}{language} Ideals.ogg |vo_02_05_tx = Wow, ever since we got a road in our village, things have been crazy! We've built so much new stuff. I've been keeping an eye on my team, making sure everyone's good—some want promotions, some need more cash for their fams, and some wanna travel. Hehe, busy days, but it feels great to be needed... I should keep it up! |vo_03_01_title = Chat: I |vo_03_01_file = {character}{language} Chat I.ogg |vo_03_01_tx = This on my head? It's my employee ID badge. Clipped it to my hair to save myself the fumbling when I'm carrying stuff. Now everyone knows my name in a snap. Perfect! |vo_03_02_title = Chat: II |vo_03_02_file = {character}{language} Chat II.ogg |vo_03_02_tx = That day, I left my village, hiked over the mountain, farther than anyone else had gone before. I soon found myself in a vast field, the air fresh and damp with dew. I was so pumped that I started to glow, and the light attracted {{Extra Effect|Tacet Discords|Tacet Discord|Tacet Discords, beings created by the Waveworn Phenomena bearing "Tacet Cores", are dangerous entities with ever-changing, amorphous forms, which feed on other frequencies to maintain stability and evolution. These creatures mimic their prey's abilities, shapes, and behaviors, influenced by the types of frequency they consume.}}... Did everything I could to fight them off, then I blacked out. Next thing I knew, a {{Extra Effect|Lollo Logistics}} team saved me, their lights cutting through the darkness, the brightest I've ever seen. |vo_04_01_title = About [[Jianxin]] |vo_04_01_intimacy = 1 |vo_04_01_file = {character}{language} About Jianxin.ogg |vo_04_01_tx = When I am out delivering packages, I can't always find a place to stay, so sometimes I rest outdoors. Once, I woke up to see Miss Jianxin napping on a boulder on the cliff edge! She seemed... so light, like a feather... |vo_04_01_mention = Jianxin |vo_04_02_title = About [[Chixia]] |vo_04_02_intimacy = 2 |vo_04_02_file = {character}{language} About Chixia.ogg |vo_04_02_tx = Ma Xiao...oops, I mean Chixia, hehe! Ahem, {{Extra Effect|Patroller|Patroller|Public Security Bureau staff who are responsible for the security issues of their jurisdictions.}} Chixia's packages are mostly snacks and hero play merchs. She was so stoked last time she got one, she practically bounced out of the room! |vo_04_02_mention = Chixia |vo_04_03_title = About [[Youhu]] |vo_04_03_intimacy = 3 |vo_04_03_file = {character}{language} About Youhu.ogg |vo_04_03_tx = Youhu's packages always come with insurance, full of pricey antiques. I don't know much about these stuff, but the way she handles them, you can tell they're her treasures. |vo_04_03_mention = Youhu |vo_04_04_title = About [[Baizhi]] |vo_04_04_intimacy = 4 |vo_04_04_file = {character}{language} About Baizhi.ogg |vo_04_04_tx = Researcher Baizhi's packages weigh a ton! Mostly stacks of books, thick ones, and a bunch of other weird stuff. Said those are for research purposes... |vo_04_04_mention = Baizhi |vo_04_05_title = About [[Zhezhi]] |vo_04_05_intimacy = 5 |vo_04_05_file = {character}{language} About Zhezhi.ogg |vo_04_05_tx = Actually, I rarely get to meet Miss Zhezhi in person… She's a night owl, barely out during the day. So I've been dropping her paints and paper at her door. |vo_04_05_mention = Zhezhi |vo_05_01_title = Birthday Wishes |vo_05_01_file = {character}{language} Birthday Wishes.ogg |vo_05_01_tx = Auntie Panhua's letting me use her stove today. In my village, we celebrate birthdays with steaming longevity noodles like this, topped with two braised eggs! Hey, you gotta slurp it all in one go, no biting allowed! Hehe… Happy birthday! May your journey ahead always be bright. |vo_06_01_title = Idle: I |vo_06_01_file = {character}{language} Idle I.ogg |vo_06_01_tx = Not delivered yet?...Come on... |vo_06_02_title = Idle: II |vo_06_02_file = {character}{language} Idle II.ogg |vo_06_02_tx = *Effort Sound* |vo_06_03_title = Idle: III |vo_06_03_file = {character}{language} Idle III.ogg |vo_06_03_tx = Squeakie! Enough playing with the letter! |vo_07_01_title = Self-Introduction |vo_07_01_file = {character}{language} Self-Introduction.ogg |vo_07_01_tx = Greetings! Lumi here! Need to send some mail? I've got you covered as {{Extra Effect|Lollo Logistics}}' professional navigator! |vo_07_02_title = Greeting |vo_07_02_file = {character}{language} Greeting.ogg |vo_07_02_tx = Don't worry, my light's got you! |vo_08_01_title = Join Team: I |vo_08_01_file = {character}{language} Join Team I.ogg |vo_08_01_tx = Right on time! |vo_08_02_title = Join Team: II |vo_08_02_file = {character}{language} Join Team II.ogg |vo_08_02_tx = A new page in my journal! |vo_08_03_title = Join Team: III |vo_08_03_file = {character}{language} Join Team III.ogg |vo_08_03_tx = Lighting up your way. |vo_09_01_title = Ascension: I |vo_09_01_ascension = 1 |vo_09_01_file = {character}{language} Ascension I.ogg |vo_09_01_tx = Is it just me, or is the light bulb on my tail brighter than before? |vo_09_02_title = Ascension: II |vo_09_02_ascension = 2 |vo_09_02_file = {character}{language} Ascension II.ogg |vo_09_02_tx = To chart new routes for {{Extra Effect|Lollo Logistics}}, physical training is a must. |vo_09_03_title = Ascension: III |vo_09_03_ascension = 3 |vo_09_03_file = {character}{language} Ascension III.ogg |vo_09_03_tx = You're an amazing teacher! Didya know? Squeakie's jumping higher and faster after your pointers! |vo_09_04_title = Ascension: IV |vo_09_04_ascension = 4 |vo_09_04_file = {character}{language} Ascension IV.ogg |vo_09_04_tx = They used to call me Jolly Sun in my village. I prefer Lumi though! The sun sets at night, but I'm always ready to illuminate someone's way home! |vo_09_05_title = Ascension: V |vo_09_05_ascension = 5 |vo_09_05_file = {character}{language} Ascension V.ogg |vo_09_05_tx = So, you are saying I'm already a top-notch navigator? Really?… No, no, don't get too comfortable, Lumi! There's still a long way to go, gotta keep it up! }} ==Combat== {{Combat VO |character = Lumi |language = en |resliberation_1_tx = Squeakie, get 'em baddies! |resliberation_2_tx = Squeakie, protect the cargo! |resliberation_3_tx = Squeakie, clear the way! |introoutro_1_tx = Together! |hit_1_tx = Squeakie, watch out! |hit_2_tx = It's breaking! |injured_1_tx = Time is ticking! |injured_2_tx = Cargo damaged! |injured_3_tx = Squeakie, run... |fallen_1_tx = Navigation... failed... |fallen_2_tx = Luminous no more... |esummon_1_tx = Awesome! |etransform_1_tx = Watch this! |enemynear_1_tx = Squeakie, alert! |glider_1_tx = The higher, the better! |sensor_1_tx = Here it is! |chest_1_tx = Woah, a great find! |chest_2_tx = Lucky me! |chest_3_tx = Check this out, Squeakie! }} ==Change History== {{Change History|1.4}} ==Navigation== {{Resonator Navbox|type=voicelines}}
